proposition: The identity of the Amīr ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn of letters 33-34 cannot be fixed: MK lists three candidates (ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn b. Bāysunghur, ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn ʿAlīka Kükältash, ʿAlāʾ al-Dawla son of the Mazandarani vizier ʿIzz al-Dīn Ṭāhir Simnānī), the first less likely because born in 1417.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK's footnote lists the candidates without choosing
